proposal_rules.title: Enforce Single-Pass Writes on Focused-Diff Tasks
proposal_rules.hypothesis: On strict-scored tasks, corrective rewrite cycles (write, verify, rewrite same path) can fail even when final file contents are correct; requiring one deliberate write per target path reduces this class of failures.
proposal_rules.change: Add a compact execution rule: before any `write`, capture exact target line formatting and prepare final replacement text; then perform at most one write per target file for the task unless the first write created invalid syntax. Treat post-write cosmetic reindent/reflow edits as disallowed in focused-diff workflows. Verification should be read-only and should not trigger formatting rewrites.
